title: If a cylinder liner is lengthened to 3500 mm, can the existing loading frame still be used?
summary: A group of Suneng cylinder-equipment discussion drafts leaves basket compatibility for 3500 mm aluminium liners unresolved. The curing section separately distinguishes cylinder-body length from total length including a centre rod. Long-cylinder equipment must be checked against the actual workpiece state at each process stage; a liner, its basket and a wound cylinder on a mandrel are not the same envelope.
coverCaption: Illustration of filament-wound gas cylinders (AI-generated). Not an actual customer workpiece photograph. One category of objects covered by this article.
